name: BN5's Liberation Missions
now: BN5's nine missions read from its ROM (the liberation state 0x020022F0, the records 0x0804F628: panels, holes, team, Darkloid and guardians, items, traps, BonusPanels, par, rewards) and opened in romlab; a generator designed on them and prototyped ROM-free (tools/liberation.py), its planner calibrated on BN5's own boards (tools/liberation_bn5.py); its liberation battle's rules read in its code (the turn's banner 0x08007954, the time up 0x08008BD2 and 0x08007C24, the win's banner 0x08007A50, the messages 0x0801B80C) and run on BN6's own battle loop, whose message table kept BN5's banners (0x0801EF84). Its Darkloids' phase traced and played on the board as BN5's: the Darkloid first, a guardian's move one warp (list 7's 59), the reach lit red, each unit's line, its strike animation, BigBrute's flame and the harm in BN5's yellow digits, BN5's sounds; TinHawk's HawkAttack, Bladia's DarkSlash and the Darkloid's blow (list 7's 58, the board shaken) and a deleted guardian's return (rising on its DarkHole in OBJ mosaic, warping beside it) traced and played as BN5's. Its par's prize traced (0x08052DD0, the end's step 0x0804EA2E, the text 0x087E866C) and played at each tier in romlab; the run pays its tiers. The board's HP traced and played as BN5's: each unit's HP under it in BN5's white digits (0x080533A0, 0x0805341A, 0x08053482), stepped 4 a frame; a fought unit's battle from its board HP and back (0x08053B9E, 0x08009050); the Darkloid's heal in his phase, a tenth of his max per dark panel round him (0x080560AC, 0x08053D04, weights 0x08050334), its effect list 7's 120 in its third palette. Its BonusPanel traced in play and built as BN5's: freed by Liberation without a battle or the Navi's action, three flashes, the roulette on the phase banner's band (state 0x0200ABB0, list 9's icons and words), its five slots in the records' order (no harm for a phase, HP full, five Order Points, one of four chips, the nearest guardian deleted or a fifth of the Darkloid's max HP). Each mission's own look traced and drawn: the nine maps share one tile set and BN5's overlay; a mission brings its map, one of five backdrops (BN5_LIB_MISSION_BACKDROPS 0x0807416C) and one of two board palettes, loaded over the map's by the mission's GFXAnim list (BN5_LIB_MISSION_ANIMS 0x08073E70: missions 1-5 0x08614DD4, 6-9 0x08615100); every dark layer takes the mission of the BN5 area that dresses its area (lib_look_mission). Its mission's opening, L view and clear traced: the Darkloid's first word at his first turn, the L view's keys, SUCCESS! and the leader's tally read from BN5's text at run time. The team in the engine: the run's Soul Navis on the board, each his turn (R and each action passing play on, as BN5's mission 2 plays), his command, his HP (BN5's table), his battle MegaMan in his Soul from the first turn (the record written at OK, 0x08029110), the Navi in play BN6's player in his own BN5 body (0x0809E7EA). Its commands traced in BN5's code and played: each Navi's window from a mask per Navi id (0x08050048), each command's check, step and after-battle step by its id (0x08055778, 0x0804C428, 0x0804D308), its panels from a shape per Navi id (0x08050344); Team Colonel's ROM holds Team ProtoMan's commands whole (WideSwrd, BombLiberation, PanelSearch, Napalm, MagnetBarrier, TwinLiberation) and their texts, and the guides' shapes match BN5's tables.
left: TwinLiberation's second half and Save traced, which of a guardian's battle's enemies its record marks (its board HP's), BN5's "Surrounded!" line in BN6's battle, BN5's board tiles for drawing dark panels at run time; then the board in BN6's engine (docs/game/liberation/building/overview.md).
